Fora da proteção do campo magnético da T: Outside the protection of Earth's magnetic field, radiation is constant. During the cruise to Mars, the RAD instrument aboard Curiosity measured about 1.8 mSv per day.

A gravidade é 38% da terrestre e a press: Gravity is 38% of Earth's and atmospheric pressure is less than 1% of Earth's. A Martian day, a sol, lasts 24h39min. Nights drop to tens of degrees below zero.
Lição: o traje fica pressurizado o tempo: Lesson: the suit stays pressurized at all times. Plan the EVA around your oxygen supply.
O solo marciano contém percloratos, sais: Martian soil contains perchlorates, salts that are toxic to humans. The Phoenix lander detected them in 2008, and Curiosity also found them in Gale Crater.

Em 2013, o Curiosity perfurou as rochas: In 2013, Curiosity drilled the rocks of Yellowknife Bay and found clay minerals. A lake of low-salinity, neutral-pH water once existed there, an environment that could have supported microbial life.
Lição: rochas sedimentares finas, como l: Lesson: fine-grained sedimentary rocks, like mudstones, are the best targets when looking for signs of habitability.
Fonte: NASA/JPL-Caltech · MSL (Grotzinge: Source: NASA/JPL-Caltech · MSL (Grotzinger et al., Science, 2014)
As Dunas Bagnold são dunas ativas, que s: The Bagnold Dunes are active dunes that move with the wind. Curiosity studied them in 2015 and 2016. In 2009, the Spirit rover got stuck in soft soil and never got out.
Lição: evite areia fofa e teste o solo a: Lesson: avoid soft sand and test the ground before moving ahead with cargo.

O Opportunity funcionava com energia sol: Opportunity ran on solar power. In June 2018, a dust storm covered the entire planet, and the last contact with the rover was on June 10, 2018. NASA ended the mission in February 2019, after almost 15 years on Mars. Curiosity uses a nuclear power source and kept operating.

Na superfície, o RAD mediu em média cerc: On the surface, RAD measured an average of about 0.64 mSv per day. A solar particle event can raise the dose quickly. The event's rates and warning time in this game are simulated.
Lição: monitore os alertas de clima espa: Lesson: monitor space weather alerts and always keep a shelter a few minutes away.

No fim de 2013, os furos e rasgos nas ro: In late 2013, the holes and tears in Curiosity's aluminum wheels grew quickly while it crossed terrain with sharp rocks. The team began looking for smoother routes, inspecting the wheels often and testing driving in reverse.
Lição: rochas assim também podem cortar: Lesson: rocks like these could also cut suits. Go around them when you can and inspect your gear when you return.
São redes de cristas na rocha. Água subt: They are networks of ridges in the rock. Groundwater deposited minerals in fractures, and erosion later removed the surrounding rock, leaving the ridges standing out. Curiosity studied these formations in 2025, on Mount Sharp.
Lição: essas cristas registram água subt: Lesson: these ridges record groundwater after the lakes dried up. It's science that can only be done on site.
As rochas de Yellowknife Bay ficaram exp: The rocks of Yellowknife Bay were exposed about 80 million years ago, when wind eroded the layers covering them. For Martian geology, that is a recent exposure.
Lição: superfícies expostas há menos tem: Lesson: more recently exposed surfaces have spent less time under surface radiation.

É uma das Dunas Bagnold. A face a favor: It is one of the Bagnold Dunes. Its downwind face slopes about 28° and stands about 5 m tall. Orbital images show these dunes advance up to about 1 m per Earth year.
Lição: dunas mudam de lugar. Atualize a: Lesson: dunes move. Update your route with recent images.
Em 30/05/2024 (sol 4.200), o Curiosity p: On May 30, 2024 (sol 4,200), Curiosity drove over a rock in the Gediz Vallis channel, nicknamed Convict Lake, and cracked it open. Inside were yellow crystals of pure sulfur, identified by the APXS instrument. It was the first time pure sulfur was found on Mars.
Lição: descobertas podem surgir por acas: Lesson: discoveries can happen by chance. Record everything, even what turns up under your feet.

Dia 112 de viagem. O alarme tocou de mad: Day 112 of the trip. The alarm went off before dawn and we spent hours squeezed into the shelter. Outside, the Sun never stops. In here, I learned that fear can also be measured in mSv.
Sol 1. Dei o primeiro passo e quase pule: Sol 1. I took my first step and almost jumped too high: here I weigh a little over a third of what I weighed at home. The sky is the color of caramel, and the silence is absolute. Without the suit, I wouldn't last a minute.
Keli avisou pelo rádio: \"Limpa o traje: Keli said over the radio: "Clean your suit before coming in." This red dust is beautiful, but it's poison.
Toquei uma rocha que um dia foi lama no: I touched a rock that was once mud at the bottom of a lake. Real water, calm, with neutral pH. Maybe something lived here. I stood still for a while, just looking.
O vento levou milhões de anos para desco: The wind took millions of years to uncover this slab. For Mars, that's yesterday. I'm the first person to touch it.
As dunas parecem macias, mas o Spirit fi: The dunes look soft, but Spirit got stuck in sand like this and never got out. Tatu complained every meter. We went around.
Uma parede de areia escura com a altura: A wall of dark sand as tall as a house. And it moves: up to a meter a year. Today's map won't work tomorrow.
A bateria do traje caiu para 30%. Lembre: My suit battery dropped to 30%. I remembered Opportunity, which fell asleep in a dust storm and never woke up. I turned off the instruments and kept walking.
Alerta: uma erupção solar. Quarenta e ci: Alert: a solar flare. Forty-five minutes to take cover. I ran like never before inside a suit. Reaching the shelter was the best hug of my life.
As pedras aqui são facas. Foram pedras a: The stones here are knives. Rocks like these punched holes in Curiosity's wheels. Today they scraped my suit. A small cut, but the air is unforgiving.
Pisei numa pedra e ela quebrou. Dentro,: I stepped on a rock and it broke. Inside, yellow crystals, shining. Curiosity found something like this by chance, in 2024. Mars keeps surprises under our feet.
Cheguei. Cristas cruzadas, como as pared: I made it. Crossing ridges, like the walls of a stone honeycomb. Water flowed underground long after the lakes dried up. I stored the sample with shaking hands.
